column3: NASB renders “another way” as “some other way.”
NASB follows the critical text; “shouts to” is rendered “calls.”
NASB follows the critical text; “bring out” is rendered “puts forth.”
NASB follows the critical text; it adds “simply.”
NASB follows the critical text; “whose own the sheep are not” is rendered “who is not the owner of the sheep.”
NASB follows the critical text; it omits “and” at the start.
NASB renders the present “takes away” as “has taken … away” (a reading of some manuscripts); “of Myself” is rendered “on My own initiative.”
NASB follows the critical text without “therefore.”
NASB follows the critical text; “declarations” is rendered “sayings.”
NASB follows the critical text; it moves “it was winter” to v. 23.
NASB begins with “it was winter” from v. 22; “porch” is rendered “portico.”
NASB renders “hold our soul in suspense” as “keep us in suspense.”
NASB follows the critical text without “as I said to you.”
NASB has “who … is greater than all,” the reading of the Textus Receptus and many manuscripts; the critical text reads “What My Father has given Me is greater than all.”
